how.heading: From hello to a plan you'll actually love — in 4 simple steps
how.description: No clinics. No paperwork. Just a warm, guided experience — start to finish in under a week.

details.title: Share your details
details.body: Tell us a little about you — your goals, lifestyle and what you'd like help with. Your information stays fully private.

slot.title: We confirm your slot
slot.body: Our wellness team reaches out on WhatsApp or call to lock in a time that works for you — including evenings and weekends.

meet.title: Meet your expert 1-on-1
meet.body: Hop on a secure video call with a certified coach. They'll listen, understand your routine and answer everything you've been wondering about.

plan.title: Get your personalised plan
plan.body: Receive a tailored wellness roadmap — nutrition, habits, sleep and follow-up — designed around your body and your day.

length.question: How long is a consultation?
length.answer: A private 1-on-1 session with a certified coach lasts 30–45 minutes.

privacy.question: Is my information private?
privacy.answer: Yes. Sessions are 100% private, and the details you share stay fully confidential.

after.question: What do I get after the call?
after.answer: You receive a personalised wellness plan — nutrition, habits, sleep and follow-up — with lifetime access, including a custom nutrition plan, a daily habit guide and a free follow-up check-in.

reschedule.question: Can I reschedule?
reschedule.answer: Yes. You can reschedule anytime. Our wellness team reaches out within 2 hours to confirm a time that works for you.
